== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Trample (PC Errata 2017 slip)]]. Compared with [[Trample (PC Errata 2019 disc card)]] (by 18 August 2019). The disc card (lower part, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2017 slip; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>178a3cf6a4fc00d19473ee2fb197ff0e8dcc41c4</code>.

Fair use rationale: crops of copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card images, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (errata by the Players Committee), used only to show the differences between versions on this non-commercial fan wiki.
